## Scraping the FSB Directory
```{r}
# List of FSB departments
# the URL for Information Systems & Analytics uses %20 for spaces
dept = c('Accountancy', 'Economics', 'Entrepreneurship', 'Finance', 
         'Information%20Systems%20--%20Analytics', 'Marketing', 'Management')

# create an empty data frame
courses_df = data.frame()

# loop through each department
for (dept_name in dept) {
  
  # create the URL for the current department
  dept_url = paste0("https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/", 
                    dept_name, "/all")
  
  # read the department webpage
  webpage = rvest::read_html(dept_url)
  
  # find all table rows on the webpage
  rows = rvest::html_elements(webpage, "tr")
  
  # get the department name from the first faculty row
  department_name = rvest::html_element(rows[2], "td:nth-child(1)") |>
    rvest::html_text2() |>
    trimws()
  
  # create empty lists
  department = c()
  name = c()
  position = c()
  website = c()
  
  # loop through the faculty rows skipping the header
  for (row in rows[2:length(rows)]) {
    
    # extract the department
    department = c(department,
                   rvest::html_element(row, "td:nth-child(1)") |>
                     rvest::html_text2() |>
                     trimws())
    
    # extract the name
    name = c(name,
             rvest::html_element(row, "td:nth-child(3) strong a") |>
               rvest::html_text() |>
               trimws())
    
    # extract the position
    position = c(position,
                 rvest::html_element(row, "td:nth-child(3) i") |>
                   rvest::html_text2() |>
                   trimws())
    
    # extract the website
    website = c(website,
                rvest::html_element(row, "td:nth-child(3) a") |>
                  rvest::html_attr("href"))
  }
  
  # combine into the data frame
  df = data.frame(
    department = department,
    name = name,
    position = position,
    website = website
  )
  
  # keep only rows belonging to the current department
  # some department pages contain entries from other departments
  df = df[df$department == department_name, ]
  
  # add this department's data to the overall data frame
  courses_df = rbind(courses_df, df)
}

head(courses_df)
```
